Security policy

Source: .github/SECURITY.md

Supported versions

Only the latest version of fasttrop gets security fixes. The latest version is the version on the main branch.

Report a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a vulnerability. Use the private report of GitHub instead:

  1. Open the page https://github.com/farach/fasttrop/security/advisories/new.
  2. Describe the problem and the steps to cause it.
  3. Give the version of fasttrop and the operating system.

The maintainer reads each report and replies as soon as possible. The package has C code, so a report of a memory error is in scope. Examples are a buffer that is too small, or a read outside of an array.

Keep private data out of public text

Issues, pull requests, and examples are public. Do not put private data in them. Use a small panel from trop_simulate() or a panel of random numbers to show a problem. Do not paste credentials, file paths of your computer, or data that you do not have the right to share.

On this page

Developed by Alex Farach. The TROP method is from Athey, Imbens, Qu, and Viviano (2026). The authors of the method did not write this package.
